text.p: All objects and circuits were designed and built by Erik Siegel.
He works from The Netherlands and builds working electromechanical objects with a theatrical touch, using old, new and salvaged parts.

Over the years, I’ve acquired a large number of electronic components, mostly through the acquisition of secondhand batches of parts. There are so many now that I will probably never be able to use them all in my lifetime. I've made an inventory of all my components. Most is for sale, for a friendly price.
Professionally, Erik works as a content engineer, XML expert and technical writer. Visit the Xatapult company website for more information.
